verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents importing existing subscriptions from competing billing systems (Zuora, Recurly, Chargify, Chargebee) and offers a no-code Billing migration toolkit. It also describes a multi-step migration of customer and payments data. However, the evidence never states that card data transfer is PCI-compliant, never mentions spreadsheet or CSV import, and never says the migration is invisible to customers. Missing for 10: explicit PCI-compliant card/payment-method transfer documentation, spreadsheet/CSV import path, evidence of seamless no-customer-impact cutover, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing

citations.quote: You can import existing subscriptions from third-party billing systems (such as Zuora, Recurly, Chargify, or Chargebee) into Stripe Billing.
Use the Billing migration toolkit to migrate your subscriptions without writing code.
Migrating your customer and payments data to Stripe is a multi-step process.
